```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent-decl "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Text'>">
  %ent-decl;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY binary-data SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/main" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns/sub" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Top level comment exercising parser comments -->
  <sub:child xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing markup <tags> and entities &internal; inside.
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % parameter-entity "<!ENTITY sec-ent 'Secret Value'>">
  %parameter-entity;
  <!ENTITY combined "&sec-ent; and more">
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction target="db" action="initialize"?>
<database xmlns="http://example.org/db" xmlns:meta="http://example.org/db/meta">
  <!-- Comment before CDATA and namespace prefix usage -->
  <meta:record id="rec1">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw payload with <tag> & entities.
    ]]>
  </meta:record>
  <record>&combined;</record>
</database>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Value One">
  <!ENTITY e2 "&e1; Value Two">

  <!ENTITY photo SYSTEM "photo.jpg" NDATA jpeg>
]>

      Unparsed character data with special chars <>&"'
    ]]>
  </store:item>
  <item>&e2;</item>
</inventory>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book)*>
  <!ELEMENT book (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % p-ent "<!ENTITY ref 'ReferenceText'>">
  %p-ent;
  <!ENTITY external-sys SYSTEM "file.txt">
]>
<?xml-debug level="high" mode="verbose"?>

    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block enclosing <book> structure and &ref;
    ]]>
  </lib:book>
  <book>&ref;</book>
</catalog>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (document)*>
  <!ELEMENT document (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY derived "&base;Derived">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc SYSTEM "doc.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-target param="value"?>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/schema" xmlns:ns1="http://archive.org/schema/ns1">
  <!-- Archive header comment block -->
  <ns1:document>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with complex content & derived entities.
    ]]>
  </ns1:document>
  <document>&derived;</document>
</archive>

</system>
